issue_request: FHIR-46045 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for R6. It asked whether SubscriptionTopic.trigger.queryCriteria.previous and current FHIR query strings should be URL-encoded, with the approved resolution to document that they are not URL-encoded by default and that implementers should defensively check.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR 3967 was merged as 2ec3e732 and contains commit bdde3098ba, which added a SubscriptionTopic Query Trigger Definitions paragraph saying the previous/current query strings are not required to be URL-encoded and that implementers should check both URL-encoded and non-URL-encoded forms.
additional_context: SubscriptionTopic is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml feeds the current build. Later SubscriptionTopic query-criteria work, including FHIR-47375 and FHIR-50619, refined definitions and narrative behavior but preserved the URL-encoding paragraph. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-07-08 match the Jira resolution, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative SubscriptionTopic narrative already contains the approved URL-encoding guidance for previous and current query criteria.
